changes: Adapted to PhotoKamo’s grouped engine controls and Web Worker runtime; calibration data is unmodified.
2026-11-26 (v3 Task 3): SpectralDataStore no longer caches a failed load, so a look can be retried after a network error without a reload (test/store.test.js).
2026-11-27 (v3 Task 13): LICENSE.md states the proprietary terms; the credits link to it instead of the repository.

2026-11-27 (v3 Task 8): creative-look grain above 900 px is a smooth field sized to the picture, and spectral sharpening scales its radius with the full picture, so exports viewed at preview size match the preview (test/scale.test.js); previews up to 900 px are unchanged.

2026-11-27 (v3 Task 9): spectral grain and the final dither are functions of the position in the full frame (hashed, no sequential RNG), and new exports tileMargin / tileRects let a frame render in tiles that equal the single-pass render within 1/255 (test/tiles.test.js).
